findings.title: Unsupported analytic 0.5*exp(-5) rate-sensitivity bound and overstated rate-law / energy-partition claims in R1, R2, and R3
findings.source_check: Accepted transient-versus-final distinction and rejection of unsupported homogeneous bound; retain dt.1-only qualification and do not claim unique stress/energy mechanism.

findings.title: Flawed topological identities and unverified ensemble constraints in R1 and R3 rewiring proposals
findings.source_check: Accepted graph identities and need to specify constraints; generic symmetric2-switches do not necessarily require a nontrivial correction, and density matching alone is not causal isolation.

findings.title: Enforcement of the predeclared per-case time-step gate (<= 1e-4) versus paired-contrast drift and surviving effect sizes
findings.source_check: Accepted measured per-case and contrast drift; no asymptotic-error, exact zero-step or null-equivalence claim.

findings.title: Torus cycle winding rank versus directional wrap flags and positive-G0 conditioning versus solver failure
findings.source_check: Accepted metric and conditioning distinctions; no universal phase threshold or full-rigidity conclusion.

findings.title: Unsupported RNG permutation-nesting claim in R3 versus intentional paired-seed blocking and non-independent model review
findings.source_check: Accepted dependence and unsupported nesting correction; variance reduction is possible rather than guaranteed.
